_about: NIST Atomic Spectra Database (SRD 78), neutral-atom spectra, every row in 380-750 nm for which NIST gives a transition probability. One entry per NIST row (one classified transition), sorted by wavelength. nm = wavelength in standard air as NIST gives it (no vacuum conversion); wl = "obs" (NIST observed wavelength) or "ritz" (NIST Ritz wavelength, used where NIST lists no observed one). Aki = transition probability in s^-1. Ek_eV = upper level energy in eV as returned by NIST (the query asked for eV; no conversion here). gk = upper level statistical weight. acc = NIST accuracy grade of Aki. rel = NIST relative intensity number or null when NIST gives none; flag = descriptors stripped from it (present only when not empty; "*" means the intensity is shared by several rows with the same observed wavelength, so do not sum it). type = NIST transition type (M1, E2, ...) present only for non-electric-dipole rows. Na rows whose NIST lower configuration is not built on the closed 2p6 core carry core_excited: true. H holds only the configuration-averaged rows (n = 2 to n = 3..9); the fine-structure component rows are left out. See SOURCES.md.
